payload.title: Gupshup Console Overview
payload.query_preview: in the context of meta business ai (mba), provide implementation-accurate answers to these five questions: 1) does gupshup support the meta thread control api for mba to hand over conversations to gupshup-managed agents? 2) does gupshup subscribe to and consume message echoes for messages sent by mba? 3) does gupshup persist those echoes and render them inline in the agent's thread, with ai turns …
